scope: Operator report, Field Collector review, farm-activity, and inventory pagination contracts
finding: Six operator list handlers relied only on service validation, so OpenAPI did not publish their bounds and invalid limits reached route handlers before rejection.
change: All six routes now expose limit (or device_limit) with default 50 and bounds 1..100. FastAPI rejects invalid values before service access. Service-level regressions also confirm mobile review, farm-activity intake, and farm-activity lifecycle list bounds reject before opening a connection.

checks.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_operator_auth.py tests/test_operator_mobile_review.py tests/test_farm_activity_workflow.py tests/test_farm_activity_lifecycle.py tests/test_farm_activity_routes.py -q

rollback: Revert the six Query annotations, focused route/service regressions, and this evidence file; no schema or persisted data changed.
limitations: The checks establish in-process OpenAPI and validation behavior, not live ingress or database availability.
